_comment: Configuration registry for the congruencey package tooling. Every registry-gated tool (file-system-repair/*.py, and future package tools) walks UP the tree to find this file and throws if it cannot see it (see note-for-claude). It lives at the package/mono root; in the folded big-jazz layout that root is this repo, so paths.mono is '.'.

php_provision._comment: No pinned url: provision_php.platform_download picks the static-php-cli build for THIS host's os+arch, so macOS arm64 runs a native arm64 php (no x86 emulation). Set download.url only to force a specific asset.
